parsed.note_claim: The photo does not show Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip bowing to Haile Selassie but unidentified guests bowing at an event years before the royal family visited Ethiopia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: This image of two unidentified guests greeting Ethiopian Emperor Haile Selassie and Empress Menen Asfaw does not show Queen Elizabeth II and Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh. The photo was taken 10 years before the British royal visit to Ethiopia.
parsed.reason: The Reuters fact check directly states the photo shows unidentified guests in 1955, ten years before the royal couple's 1965 visit, matching the note's claim.
